**Gourd Soup** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

A peeled and sliced gourd and boiled water, cooked together into a soup.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Boiled Water (1) Gourd (1) Wood (2) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Gourd | | Gourd Soup (1) | 

- Can be crafted at any Cooking Station, after having picked up a gourd for the first time.
- Can be found in the Communist Collectron Station, when it is set to run in "Proletariat" mode.
